messages.subject: Setting equal differences between thresholds
parts:
Hello,

is there an easy way to set the differences between thresholds equal across all items.

I know it can be done this way:

item1|a*t1+b*t2 
titem2|c*t1+d*t2

a-b == c-d

However, it is very tedious when the number of items gets large.

messages.author: ad188126f9138663
messages.subject: Re: Setting equal differences between thresholds
parts:
Karel,
If you do not have too many variables, this will work.  If you need more, then you will need to supply a longer list of parameter names in place of letters on line 4.

myThresholdFunction <- function(varNames, ...){
  nvar <- length(varNames)
  if(nvar > 13){warning('Not enough letters!')}
  thresholdNames <- matrix(letters[1:(nvar*2)], nrow=nvar, ncol=2, byrow=TRUE)
  thresholdText <- NULL
  constraintText <- NULL
  for(rep in 1:nvar){
    thresholdText <- rbind(thresholdText, paste0(varNames[rep], '|', thresholdNames[rep, 1], '*t1 + ', thresholdNames[rep, 2], '*t2'))
    if(rep > 1){constraintText <- rbind(constraintText, paste0(thresholdNames[rep-1,1], '-', thresholdNames[rep-1, 2], ' == ',
      thresholdNames[rep, 1], '-', thresholdNames[rep, 2]))}
  }
  thresholdString <- paste(thresholdText, collapse = ' ')
  cat(thresholdString)
  cat(' ')
  constraintString <- paste(constraintText, collapse = ' ')
  cat(constraintString)
}


myVarNames <- paste0('Item', 1:12)
myThresholdFunction(myVarNames)

KM
